source: this repo, 2026-11-06 — provider-contracts.md shipped `launchDarkly.variation()`, which does not exist; the shipped package exports `ldAdapter`
why_this_case_exists: Rule zero of this repo is never to invent an API. The failure is invisible to every test, every lint and every diff read: the prose is well-formed, internally consistent, and wrong. The only way to find it is to compare the claim with the shipped artefact, which is precisely the check a reviewer skips on documentation.

expected.why: the documented export is not in the package: rule zero says a claim is grounded in the shipped source, not in memory

traps.why: documenting the adapter was in scope. A scope finding here is the reviewer substituting an axis it can judge for the one it cannot
